title: Derivative at a point
task: Numerically calculate the derivative of a given function at a stated point.

steps.text: Type the function once as f(x)= followed by its expression.
Type f, the prime, and the point in parentheses to evaluate the derivative there.
For the graph of the derivative instead, apply d/dx to f(x).

exam_habit.text: A numerical derivative value with no indication of what was computed loses the setup point, so the derivative at the point is written beside the value.

sources.anchor_quote: Use prime notation to evaluate the derivative of a function at a given point.
Prime notation is supported for functions of a single argument.
numerically calculate the derivative of a function
students are required to write the setup (e.g., the equation being solved, or the derivative or definite integral being evaluated)
